programs.title: Tesla's Death Ray: A Murder Declassified
programs.desc: The series presents the achievements of the famous inventor Nikola Tesla and conspiracy theories regarding his mysterious death.The engineer from Serbia is the author of nearly 300 patents, most of which are still used by people today.His working methods, including his experiments, aroused much controversy, which made him considered an eccentric and dangerous person.When he died unexpectedly in his New York apartment in 1943, his notes on his work were allegedly stolen.This gave rise to numerous conjectures and alleged scenarios of events.

programs.title: Cooper's Treasure: The Hunt For A Secret Fortune
programs.desc: One of the pioneers of the conquest of space, Gordon Cooper, worked secretly on a map of shipwrecks for several decades.This idea was born accidentally, in the 1960s, during a mission whose aim was to search for atomic test sites on Earth carried out by the USSR.Using information he gained while orbiting the Earth, Cooper located over 100 shipwrecks.Already on Earth, he marked them on sea maps and thus a real treasure map was created.It was a secret until 2002.Two years before his death, the sick Cooper left it to a younger colleague, Darrell Miklos, who revealed it years later.The series shows how treasure hunters reach sunken ships and penetrate their interiors.
